name: Deel
tagline: Hire and pay contractors and staff in any country
description: Deel provides contractor payments, global payroll and employer-of-record services, so a small company can hire abroad without opening a local entity.
priceNote: Contractor management and global payroll start at $49 per contractor/month, the US PEO starts at $125 per employee/month and EOR starts at $599 per employee/month, with employer-side taxes and benefits extra. Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Small companies hiring contractors and staff across many countries
pros: Contractors get paid in their local currency with invoices and tax forms handled in-platform
Employer of record removes the need for a local entity before you hire anyone abroad
A reviewed contract library covers contractor agreements for dozens of countries
One dashboard shows who is being paid what, in which currency, and at what cost
cons: EOR at $599 per employee per month is a heavy fixed cost for a company with thin margins
Employer-side taxes, benefits and currency conversion are extra and vary by country
Payment runs take longer than a direct bank transfer, sometimes several days per cycle
Country-specific legal questions still need a local lawyer for anything unusual

features.name: Contractor payments
features.detail: Global payouts, compliant contracts and tax documents for contractors

features.name: Employer of record
features.detail: Employ someone abroad with local payroll, benefits and filings handled

features.name: Global payroll
features.detail: Run payroll for your own entity across many countries in one flow

features.name: Contracts and templates
features.detail: Reviewed contractor agreements with e-signature for dozens of countries

features.name: Deel AI
features.detail: Automated pay-run checks and anomaly flags before any money moves

features.name: Integrations
features.detail: Connect with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and the rest of your HR stack

useCases: Hire a designer in another country as a contractor without setting up an entity there
Convert a long-term contractor into a local employee through EOR when volume justifies it
Pay a distributed team of five people in four currencies from a single dashboard
Give an HR-free founder a clean view of total labour cost per country
bestForWho: Small global companies hiring across borders that cannot yet justify local entities or a payroll operator.
verdict: Deel solves a problem that stops small companies from hiring the right person: paying a contractor abroad compliantly without registering anything. Contractor management is the entry point most teams need, and the contract library removes the legal guesswork that usually stalls a first hire abroad. Employer of record is the expensive tier, and at $599 per employee per month it only makes sense once the alternative is a local entity with its own payroll and filings. The costs people forget are employer-side taxes, benefits and the currency conversion on top of the headline fee, so the real figure lands above the sticker price. The dashboard is quietly the best part for a founder without an HR team, since it shows total labour cost per country in one view.
